chains.name: The Night's Clockwork
chains.blurb: The blackout and the fall -- the night's two fixed points, plus the ledger that orders them.

chains.name: What Went in the Glass
chains.blurb: A film above the liquor line, a film at the shoulder, petals the fire missed.

chains.name: A Door Off the Bolt
chains.blurb: Someone crossed the garden in the dark and left prints nobody in the house can own.

chains.name: Paper & Money
chains.blurb: A will reworded, a confession torn, forgeries sold -- the paper trail of three quiet greeds.

chains.name: Small Things & False Trails
chains.blurb: Buttons, scissors and bottles -- the house's little red herrings.

chains.name: The Dark Half Hour
chains.blurb: Twenty-one minutes of darkness: a lantern, a burnt loaf, a wireless singing to nobody -- and wet treads on the kitchen flags.

chains.name: The Household's Hours
chains.blurb: Worn carpet lanes and rinsed glasses -- the quiet habits that map who moved, and when.
